_comment: Copy to ~/.reelmimic/secrets.json (outside the repo). Every key is optional.
FFMPEG_DIR: folder containing ffmpeg/ffprobe if they are not on PATH
CHROME_PATH: path to Chrome if it is not in the default location
CODEX_BIN: path to a specific codex CLI if an old one shadows it on PATH
CODEX_SANDBOX: Codex sandbox mode (default danger-full-access; workspace-write blocks the Chrome renderer)
PYTHON: path to a Python 3.10+ interpreter if the wrong one is found
MAX_AGENTS: agents running at once across all projects (default 12)
UPLOAD_POST_KEY: optional: post finished videos with npm run post-video (upload-post.com API key)
UPLOAD_POST_USER: optional: the Upload-Post profile your social accounts are connected to
LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET: optional: LINE bot for progress and notifications (docs/LINE.md); needs the access token too
LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: optional: the LINE channel's long-lived access token
LINE_PORT: the LINE webhook's own port, the only one to put behind an HTTPS tunnel (default 4319)
